versions.content: The associated RTE Implementation Plug-In shall pro- vide the Rte_Rips_NotifyTriggerTransmit Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an LdComApiType which has Ld- ComTxTriggerTransmit configured [SWS_LDCOM_00047].

The associated Local Software Cluster Communica- tion Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_NotifyTriggerTransmit Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled 860 of 1447 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R22-11 AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an LdComApiType which has Ld- ComTxTriggerTransmit configured [SWS_LDCOM_00047].

AND • the Communication Graph references an ComIPdu which has COM_TX_- TRIGGER_TRANSMIT configured [SWS_COM_00915].
